feats.title: Novice Power
feats.requirements: Level 3+, any class-specific multiclass feat, any encounter power with a level
feats.description: You can swap one encounter attack power you know for one encounter attack power of the same level or lower from the class you multiclassed into.

feats.title: Acolyte Power
feats.description: You can swap one utility power you know for one utility power of the same level or lower from the class you multiclassed into. You can swap one daily attack power you know for one daily attack power of the same level or lower from the class you multiclassed into.

feats.title: Adept Power
feats.requirements: Level 11+, Novice Power feat, Acolyte Power feat
feats.description: You can swap one level 1 at-will attack power you know for one level 1 at-will attack power from the class you multiclassed into.
